assessments.name: miniCISO — payments API review
assessments.objective: Assess the payments API before onboarding a new merchant.

evidence.title: Order endpoint responses
evidence.content: GET /v2/orders/{id} returns other merchants' orders with no ownership check; reproduced across two API keys.

evidence.title: Auth middleware source
evidence.content: JWT signature verified but the 'aud' claim is not checked; tokens are accepted across environments.

evidence.title: Terraform for the API
evidence.content: security group ingress 0.0.0.0/0 on 8443; WAF not attached to the staging listener.

evidence.title: Dependency manifest
evidence.content: requests==2.19.1 (old); no automated dependency scanning configured.

outputs.title: Broken object-level authorization on /v2/orders
outputs.qaNote: Reproduced across two merchants; scope and impact confirmed.
outputs.residualRisk: All merchants' order data is enumerable until ownership checks are enforced.
outputs.detail: Sequential/opaque order IDs are readable across merchants (BOLA).

outputs.title: JWT audience not validated
outputs.detail: The 'aud' claim is unchecked, so a token minted for one environment is accepted in another.

outputs.title: Staging API is internet-reachable without a WAF
outputs.detail: 0.0.0.0/0 ingress and no WAF on the staging listener. Not a finding on its own.

outputs.title: Outdated dependency may carry known CVEs
outputs.detail: requests 2.19.1 is old; needs an SCA pass to confirm exploitable CVEs.

outputs.title: No evidence on rate limiting / anti-automation
outputs.detail: Need traffic captures to assess brute-force and enumeration defenses before concluding.
